dogecoin.text: The thing that irks me about all of this is that his criticism of #Bitcoin implies he wants crypto to be a meritocracy, but his support of #dogecoin implies he doesn’t. Criticize #Bitcoin if that’s what you want to do, but promote better cryptos!

This is the bear case for #dogecoin and #safemooon—there are literally thousands of coins with the same degree of merit that could be pumped at the whims of random influential people trying to leverage their influence—but that kind of thing SHOULD be self-limiting.
